# Fitaa Creative

> Creative and digital marketing agency based in East Legon, Accra, Ghana, working with businesses in Ghana, the UK and beyond. Gets businesses found, chosen and fully booked: Google Business Profile and WhatsApp Business setup, premium websites with WhatsApp booking, Meta ads management, and graphic and digital design. Founded by Nigel Dzameshie.

Contact: WhatsApp or call +233 24 280 5256, email fitaaba@gmail.com. Address: 7 Boundary Rd, East Legon, Accra.

## Pages

- [Fitaa Creative](https://fitaacreative.com/): services, selected work for brands in Ghana and the UK, and the enquiry form.
- [Fully Booked by Fitaa](https://fitaacreative.com/fully-booked): the three packages in full, for any business that takes bookings or enquiries (car rentals, clinics, short-let hosts, studios and more), in Ghana, the UK and beyond. Prices are fixed in three currencies (visitors in Ghana see GHS, in the UK GBP, everywhere else USD). Get Found GHS 1,500 / £95 / $130 one-off, usually ready in 3 to 5 days (Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business, click-to-chat link, QR card). Get Chosen GHS 3,500 / £225 / $300 one-off, usually ready in 5 to 7 days, with three rounds of changes (a premium one-page website on your own web address, built for Google and AI answers, with WhatsApp booking). A second branch is GHS 300, £20 or $25 more. In Ghana, for hosts: up to 3 units, plus GHS 300 for each extra unit. Stay Booked GHS 1,200 / £75 / $100 a month, 3-month minimum (Meta ads management, updates, monthly report; ad budget separate). Upkeep only GHS 350 / £25 / $30 a month. Payment is once, in full, before work starts, and nothing goes live until the client approves it.
- Graphic and digital design (logos, brand identity, print, social graphics, artwork for LED and digital screens): quoted per project.
